knownDifferences.reason: the pinned route fetches an arbitrary caller-supplied URL through getUntrustedRequestAgent(), the private-request-filter SSRF agent (DNS-resolved private-address blocking, per-hop redirect validation, rebinding pinning); GoTavern has no shared private-address transport policy yet, so implementing the route now would be strictly less safe than pinned, and a route-local dial policy would violate the single-outbound-policy rule. The route is therefore absent rather than faked.
